stage1.impression: A believable misty headland: the grass scans, the boulder and the far ridges all read as real, and the fog has real depth behind the hills. But the light is flat and grey, with no dawn sun. The speaker looks parked against a rock rather than standing at the brow of a cliff. The left half of the clear cabinet dissolves into the bright fog wall. A dark mass of foreground grass takes up the bottom third, and the chrome-looking horn is the brightest, most CG-reading thing in the frame.

change.setting: fog billows / edge softness / wisps billow_cut

change.to: count 18, scale [0.15, 0.3], a 0.25 m clear ring in front
z 0.95, target z 0.80, 1.2 m further back

out_of_scope.request: The horn reads as polished chrome
out_of_scope.why: Its material is the speaker's; only its light can change
